title: SaaS Analytics Dashboard
description: A refined analytics workspace with strong hierarchy, data cards, and a clear navigation system.
prompt: Design and implement a professional SaaS analytics dashboard. Use a restrained visual language, clear information hierarchy, consistent 8px spacing, accessible contrast, a collapsible sidebar, KPI summary cards, charts with meaningful labels, a date-range control, and a responsive data table. Make all navigation and filters functional. Use realistic sample data. Avoid decorative gradients, excessive shadows, and generic filler content. Adapt the design to the existing project stack and design tokens.

title: Editorial Blog Layout
description: A typography-led publishing homepage with expressive imagery and a magazine-inspired grid.
prompt: Create a premium editorial blog homepage with a clear visual hierarchy, distinctive typographic scale, featured story, editorial card grid, categories, author metadata, and excellent long-form readability. Use a consistent spacing system and realistic editorial content. Ensure mobile layouts preserve hierarchy and legibility. Prioritize accessible contrast and meaningful imagery over decorative effects.

title: E-commerce Product Detail
description: A product-focused detail page with gallery, options, price, and confident calls to action.
prompt: Build a polished e-commerce product detail page with a responsive image gallery, thumbnail selection, variant controls, stock feedback, clear pricing, delivery information, and an accessible primary call to action. Design for product clarity and conversion, not decoration. Include keyboard interactions, loading and error states, and responsive behavior.

title: Modern Bento Grid
description: A modular asymmetric grid that balances visual interest and scannability.
prompt: Create a responsive bento grid section with varied card spans, strong content hierarchy, consistent gaps, and intentional visual rhythm. Every card must communicate a distinct feature with concise copy. Avoid arbitrary sizes and empty decorative blocks. Stack gracefully on mobile and preserve reading order.

title: Subtle Glass Surface
description: A restrained translucent card style with readable layers and soft depth.
prompt: Design a restrained glass-like UI card with subtle backdrop blur, low-opacity surface tint, a crisp border, and legible typography. Use translucency only where it supports layering. Provide a solid-color fallback and ensure text contrast remains accessible. Avoid heavy neon gradients and excessive glow.

title: Editorial Typography
description: Expressive serif headlines paired with quiet, highly legible interface typography.
prompt: Develop an editorial typography system combining a characterful display serif with a neutral, highly readable sans-serif for interface text. Define a responsive type scale, line heights, maximum text widths, weights, and hierarchy rules. Demonstrate the system in a hero, section heading, and article excerpt. Avoid overly small body text.

title: Magnetic CTA Button
description: A tactile call-to-action that responds subtly to pointer movement.
prompt: Implement a magnetic CTA button that follows pointer movement slightly while hovered and springs back on pointer leave. Keep the movement subtle, preserve click target and keyboard focus, support touch devices with a standard pressed state, and honor prefers-reduced-motion. Use transform-based animation for smooth performance.

title: Staggered Text Reveal
description: A soft entrance effect that reveals headline content with controlled timing.
prompt: Create a staggered text reveal for a hero headline. Animate opacity and vertical translation with restrained easing and a short per-line delay. Keep the text accessible and visible without JavaScript, trigger once when in view, and disable movement under prefers-reduced-motion. Avoid excessive duration.

title: Spring Toast Notification
description: A toast notification that enters smoothly, remains readable, and dismisses gracefully.
prompt: Build an accessible toast notification component with a spring-like entrance, readable status text, optional dismiss button, and a smooth exit transition. Provide success and error variants, use appropriate ARIA live region semantics, pause auto-dismiss while hovered or focused, and respect reduced-motion settings.

title: Interactive Tilt Card
description: A dimensional content card with a subtle pointer-responsive tilt.
prompt: Create an interactive content card with a subtle 3D tilt on pointer hover, a crisp focus-visible state, and clear title and metadata. Keep movement restrained and content readable. Disable tilt on touch and reduced-motion environments. Avoid layout shifts and maintain semantic link behavior.

title: Sliding Navigation Tabs
description: An animated active indicator that makes navigation state instantly clear.
prompt: Implement accessible tabs with a smoothly sliding active indicator. Support mouse, keyboard arrow navigation, Home/End keys, correct ARIA roles, and a visible focus state. Animate the indicator with transform, maintain layout stability, and respect reduced-motion preferences. Include meaningful tab panels.

title: Floating Label Field
description: An input pattern with clear focus feedback and an animated floating label.
prompt: Build a form input with an accessible floating label that moves when focused or filled. Preserve the native label association, show helpful validation messages without relying on color alone, and ensure autofill works. Use subtle transitions and support reduced motion.

title: Dashboard Hierarchy Audit
description: Turn a crowded dashboard into a clearer, more actionable interface.
prompt: Audit the existing dashboard UI without replacing its underlying functionality. Identify hierarchy, spacing, density, accessibility, and navigation issues. Improve grouping, typography, alignment, KPI prominence, and responsive behavior. Preserve existing data and flows. Explain the changes briefly and verify that interactions still work.

title: Mobile Navigation Refresh
description: Make mobile navigation easier to scan, reach, and understand.
prompt: Improve the mobile navigation of the existing application. Prioritize discoverability, thumb reach, clear active states, sensible information architecture, accessible touch targets, and keyboard/screen-reader support. Preserve the current routes and design identity. Avoid hiding critical actions behind ambiguous icons.

title: Content Loading Skeleton
description: A quiet loading state that reflects the layout of real content.
prompt: Create a content skeleton that matches the final card layout to minimize layout shifts. Use a restrained shimmer or pulse, accessible loading announcements, and reduced-motion fallback. Show realistic loading, empty, and error states, and avoid indefinite loading without feedback.
